system.description:
Advanced Move. There is always some creature or monster nearby that needs to be dealt with. Whenever you like, tell the GM there is a monster in the region. Then answer three of the questions below, and the GM will answer the remaining three questions in secret:

• How big is it?
• How many are there?
• Where is its lair?
• What are its defenses?
• What can it do?
• What valuables might it have?

When you show authorities proof that the threat is dealt with, gain 3 Wealth.
